subject: humanities
notes: Takht-i-Bahi is a Buddhist monastery near the city of Mardan in northern Pakistan.
It was founded in the first century CE and remained in use for about six hundred years.
The monastery stands on a hilltop about 150 meters above the surrounding plain.
Its remains include a courtyard of stupas, an assembly hall, and rows of small cells where monks lived.
Invading armies destroyed many monasteries on the plains below, but Takht-i-Bahi's hilltop position kept it out of their path.
It is regarded as the best-preserved Buddhist monastery in the region and was named a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1980.
stem: The student wants to explain why Takht-i-Bahi is so well preserved. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Takht-i-Bahi, which UNESCO named a World Heritage Site in 1980, is regarded as the best-preserved Buddhist monastery in the region.
choices.B: The monastery stands on a hilltop about 150 meters above the plain, and its remains include a courtyard of stupas, an assembly hall, and rows of monks' cells.
choices.C: Because Takht-i-Bahi stands on a hilltop about 150 meters above the plain, it escaped the invading armies that destroyed other monasteries and remains the best-preserved Buddhist monastery in the region.
choices.D: Takht-i-Bahi, a Buddhist monastery near the city of Mardan in northern Pakistan, was founded in the first century CE and remained in use for about six hundred years.

explanation.why: The goal asks for a cause. The notes give one: the hilltop kept the monastery out of the path of armies that destroyed monasteries on the plains. The correct sentence must connect the hilltop to the escape from destruction. Choice B mentions the hilltop but treats it only as a location, not as a reason.
explanation.A: Incorrect. It says that the monastery is well preserved but not why.
explanation.B: Incorrect. It describes the hilltop and the remains, but it never says that the hilltop protected the site, so it describes without explaining.
explanation.C: Correct. "Because" links the hilltop position to escaping the invaders and so to the monastery's preservation.
explanation.D: Incorrect. It gives location and dates but no reason for the preservation.
